minimum_support_for_v2.separability_margin: every compared class >= m = 2 independence groups in the reference AFTER removing the query's own group (so >= 3 groups per class across the development data when groups are replicated across topologies)
minimum_support_for_v2.detectability: NORMAL >= m + 1 = 3 groups in the reference after removing the query's own group

conclusion: v2 separability and detectability are undefined for every current window: only LEAK has >= 2 independent groups in any reference; NORMAL, COMPRESSOR_FAULT and COMPRESSOR_DELAY have <= 1.
